$comment: Single source of truth for what CI builds. Read by scripts/resolve-matrix.sh.
Each PHP line is resolved AT BUILD TIME to an exact upstream digest of
php:<line>-fpm-alpine — the floating tag that always follows the newest
Alpine release the official image supports. Nothing here pins Alpine:
a hand-pinned alpine3.21 is exactly how 8.4 froze on PHP 8.4.15. The
runtime stage's alpine:<minor> is read from inside that digest.
eol         after this date the line is skipped (with a warning) unless
the workflow is dispatched with include_eol=true.
max_size_mb ceiling for the amd64 runtime image, uncompressed, in MB
(10^6 bytes). A build over it fails.
prerelease  built from php:<line>-rc-fpm-alpine, allowed to fail, and
frameworks  what the weekly framework smoke tests install on each line:
a list of versions per framework, one smoke test each.
This table is also the supported-combination matrix for app
repos: a framework/PHP pair that is not listed is not tested.
